subject: make getMonotonicUs static in libvalkeylua (#4270)
reason: The change only adds `static` (and `static inline`) to getMonotonicUs, elapsedUs and elapsedMs in a fallback branch of function_lua.c that is compiled only when the engine's monotonic.h is not used. It changes symbol linkage to avoid clashes/exported symbols at link time, not any runtime behaviour: the functions compute the same values and are called the same way. This is a build-level refactor with no observable effect on commands, replies, replication, persistence or timing semantics, so no fuzzing scenario can distinguish the builds.
